summary: Rare Earths Americas, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting its subsidiary FRE US exercised an option on July 31, 2026, to acquire and assume the Weyerhaeuser Mining Lease from Southeast Metals LLC (SEM). Consideration at closing is $375,000 in cash plus $2,000,000 in the company's common stock, issued via private placement. The amendment to the original option agreement changed the target from a 100% equity acquisition to the lease assignment. Closing is subject to customary conditions, including Weyerhaeuser's approval. SEM receives piggyback registration rights and Rule 144 legend removal six months post-issuance. Watch for lease assignment completion and future dilution effects.
